motivation: Q0.4 was prospectively executed before fresh3 source outcomes and stopped on q04-writer-05 solely because the AtomCode/CodingPlan completion reached the frozen 2048-token ceiling. The bridge produced zero native-tool runtime events. Q0.5 therefore changes only the provider output ceiling while preserving exact Q0.4 synthetic conversations, bridge schema, model, timeout, and panel-specific final-text format constraints.

writer.selection_rule: choose the first candidate with 6/6 PASS; do not execute larger candidates after a PASS
writer.format_rule: nonempty valid ReasoningBank memory with 1..3 '# Memory Item i' blocks
writer.treatment_change: output ceiling only; target messages and final format unchanged

binder.selection_rule: run only after writer qualification; choose the first candidate with 6/6 PASS; do not execute larger candidates after a PASS
binder.format_rule: nonempty single-line text with at most 60 whitespace-delimited words
binder.treatment_change: output ceiling only; target messages and final format unchanged

overall_pass: writer budget selected and binder budget selected
failure_action: HOLD scientific writer/binder execution; no retry/reroll/fixture replacement/model switch
